title: File:USS Goldsborough (DDG-20) with Iraqi cargo ship Zanoobia in 1990.jpg
desc: A U.S. Navy patrol boat carrying a boarding party from the guided missile destroyer USS Goldsborough (DDG-20) pulls up alongside the Iraqi general dry cargo ship Zanoobia in the Gulf of Oman. The Zanoobia was being searched for contraband during Operation Desert Shield.
